method_change: external actual style first, original identity second
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one transparent dialogue character cutout, portrait 1024x1536, framed from entire hair bun down to mid-thigh, with both shoulders and hands fully inside frame.

REDRAW the identity of Doudeng in image 2 using the drawing language of image 1. Image 1 is the PRIMARY and controlling STYLE reference: contemporary hand-drawn mecha animation key art, restrained fine ink lines, large flat painted areas and deliberately angular hard-edged shadow planes. Its girl, helmet, uniform and background are NOT the subject. Image 2 supplies ONLY the character design identity and costume construction, not its rendering style.

Identity to keep from image 2: adult East Asian woman with assertive focused amber-brown eyes, brown high messy looped bun, industrial goggles resting on forehead, expressive side locks; teal central coveralls with ivory sleeves, rolled cuffs, black shoulder harness and belt, dark gloves, useful tool pouches and a long double ring spanner held downward. Keep her strong mechanic personality, slightly challenging expression, recognizably the same face and silhouette. Do not add a hardhat or change her into the girl in image 1.

Change the drawing method substantially: reinterpret the hair as a small number of designed graphic masses; eyes and facial contours use the restrained animation draftsmanship of image 1, NOT glossy oversized game-portrait eyes. Matte skin with one crisp nose/neck shadow, no rosy blush or skin gradients. Clothing has few purposeful angular folds and broad quiet teal/ivory planes. Reduce fine seams, scratches, etched gold chips, fabric wrinkles, micro-highlights and decorative fasteners by roughly 75 percent while retaining the major costume landmarks. Tools and goggles use just a light plane, a shade plane and a few clear construction lines; no polished metallic rendering. No all-over distress texture. Sophisticated animation model-sheet drawing, not a vector icon, children's cartoon or cel-filter over an old illustration.

Clean muted teal, warm ivory, dark charcoal and restrained brass. Fine dark warm outlines with limited weight variation; flat colors plus one hard shadow band. Neutral three-quarter standing dialogue pose, entire bun with breathing room, tool hand down and other hand at belt. Keep face and clothing equally drawn in this style. Genuine transparent alpha background, no aura, no gray backlight, no background, no labels or text. ONE single character.
